## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive (broad strength). Mixed confirmations — VXX rising but complacent VXX (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -4.31%) RECOVERY and SPY/TLT showing resilience (SPY/TLT ABOVE TREND; SPY (1W: -0.98% | 1M: +0.41%) CORRECTION vs TLT (1W: -0.95% | 1M: -2.72%) BELOW TREND) while credit signals warn (HYG (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -1.60%) BELOW TREND).

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD divergence with HYG (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -0.06%) and LQD (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -1.60%) BELOW TREND. Fear modestly higher: VXX (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -4.31%) RECOVERY. Equities vs bonds still tilted toward stocks via SPY/TLT (1W: +0.48% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tight; yield curve flattening (Yield Curve 1W: -0.71% | 1M: -2.96%) BELOW TREND and Dollar steady (Dollar 1W: +0.39% | 1M: +0.00%) NEUTRAL, while SPY (1W: -0.98% | 1M: +0.41%) CORRECTION vs TLT (1W: -0.95% | 1M: -2.72%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +9.51%) ABOVE TREND; Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -6.18%) BELOW TREND; Financials showing rotation/patchy strength: XLF (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +4.38%) CORRECTION. Style: Energy/cyclicals over growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US mixed with SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.98% | 1M: +0.41%); Europe showing stability VGK (1W: +0.78% | 1M: +0.32%) ABOVE TREND and China large caps FXI (1W: +0.44% | 1M: +2.99%) ABOVE TREND, while broad EM EEM (1W: -0.88% | 1M: -8.73%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Muted overall: ARKK (1W: -4.48% | 1M: -3.06%) BELOW TREND and IWM (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -1.47%) BELOW TREND, though IBIT (1W: +1.44% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND shows pockets of crypto demand.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Broad commodity bid led by oil and agriculture — BNO (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +19.25%) ABOVE TREND, UGA (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +19.84%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +1.13%) ABOVE TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Clear leadership in energy: XLE (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +9.51%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas lagging but bouncing: UNG (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -9.94%) RECOVERY.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +9.51%). DIVERGENCE: Major 1W vs 1M mismatches across core ETFs (SPY, XLK, XLF, TLT) — transitional market dynamics, temper conviction.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to energy/commodity themes via XLE (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +9.51%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +19.25%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to large-cap tech XLK (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -6.18%) BELOW TREND and QQQ (1W: -1.73% | 1M: -4.42%) BELOW TREND; monitor credit via HYG (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -1.60%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +9.51%) ABOVE TREND, MOO (1W: +1.95% | 1M: +8.15%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -6.18%) BELOW TREND, QQQ (1W: -1.73% | 1M: -4.42%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +19.25%) ABOVE TREND, UGA (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +19.84%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNG (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -9.94%) RECOVERY, SLV (1W: +3.28% | 1M: -8.47%) RECOVERY.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~22 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD spread near 0.75 (credit health watch); SPY/TLT ~9.0 (equities vs bonds pivot); XLK/QQQ downside confirmation if weekly closes stay below recent 1M range.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, weight of evidence mixed between commodity/energy strength and credit caution. Energy and broad commodities showing strength (XLE, BNO, UGA); key risk is the major 1W vs 1M divergence across SPY/XLK/XLF/TLT — monitor credit via HYG/LQD and volatility via VXX.
